message: 彼氏なんだから甘えてよ

name: Synn
message: 「Mmh... smells so good...」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on now, sleepyhead♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! It's freezing!」

name: Ria
message: 「If you don't hurry up and get out of bed, breakfast is gonna get cold~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai! Good morning, wait--」
When I got up, right there was--

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!! Amazing!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Guaranteed to give you tons of energy right from the morning. Packed with nutrition, it's Ria's full-course meal♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「A Ria-chan full-course meal, you say!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Morning♪ There's plenty for you too, Paa-chan.\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ugh... ughh... morning, Ria-chan... However, while I appreciate the sentiment, yours truly can no longer...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, that's unusual. You always used to jump right on it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, it seems the shock jogged my memory. About the days when yours truly ruled the roost as the Great Sage.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Amidst all that, yours truly fell in love with Lumiel, the Angel of Light.」

name: Paqy
message: 「A romance so sweet you'd practically melt. Lumiel and I were deeply in love... and I'm sure that hasn't changed even now.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So the one yours truly had feelings for wasn't Ria-chan, but her guardian angel... the lingering image of Lumiel.」

name: Ria
message: 「So that's how it was...」
Does that mean Paqy and the others have been sacrificing even themselves all this time just to protect the future from Re-Crea...?

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, Paqy. I misjudged you. You really are a Great Sage after all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「As long as you understand, that's all that matters.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, though, doesn't that mean you were cheating on Ria-senpai?」

name: Paqy
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Ria
message: 「Plus, you were staring at nothing but my boobs the whole time, weren't you...」
And lo and behold, wouldn't you know it--Ria-senpai's Rosary began to shine with a divine radiance.

name: Ria
message: 「No way, is Lumiel angry!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is this a sign of transformation--!?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-Nooo~~\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「Harami!!」
For the first time in a while, I ended up staring intently. At Senpai's naked body......

name: Paqy
message: 「Why am I the one getting squished......」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Because... I don't want anyone to see it, except for you, Synn-kun......」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeh!?」

name: Ria
message: 「O-Oh no, what am I saying!」

name: Ria
message: 「T-Take that back! Doesn't count, doesn't count!!」
S-So this is the privilege of not the Student Council President, but a boyfriend... The right to see Senpai naked...

name: Ria
message: 「Jeeez~~! Don't go imagining weird things, bad boy!」
Before I could stop myself and show some restraint, she flicked my forehead. Just as expected of Ria-senpai.

name: Paqy
message: 「Ugh... s-so cruel......\s06」
